answer: Solo signups are refused. Step 1, a joiner bonds 2,400 POA idle for 16 epochs. Step 2, a 90-second gale opens each epoch: the key must forge a fresh slot-hash signature, then a stranger two hops away on a rotating spiral of clusters countersigns after checking the bond. Step 3, late, reused, or same-cluster marks burn 600 POA and exile the key 14 epochs; a sloppy endorser loses 200 POA. One live key idles 2,400 POA; 800 clones need 1.92M POA and 800 endorsers in 90s, vs ~160 POA harvest. Weakness: rich endorser farms; mitigation: no rematch for 24 epochs and joint slashing of colluding bonds.
